content: Migraleve is a brand of medications specifically formulated to provide relief from migraines. These medications are manufactured by Pfizer and are available in two distinct variants: Migraleve Yellow and Migraleve Pink. Both variants contain the active ingredients paracetamol and codeine, which are analgesics. Migraleve Yellow is designed to alleviate symptoms of headache and general discomfort associated with migraines. In contrast, Migraleve Pink is formulated to address not only headache and discomfort but also symptoms of nausea and vomiting that often accompany migraines. Migraleve Yellow The active ingredients in Migraleve Yellow include: Paracetamol DC 96% (520 mg), equivalent to 500 mg of paracetamol. Codeine phosphate (8 mg). Additional excipients in Migraleve Yellow include: Magnesium stearate Colloidal anhydrous silica Stearic acid Pregelatinised maize starch Gelatin Hypromellose Macrogol Quinoline yellow (E104) Aluminium oxide Titanium dioxide (E171) Iron oxide yellow (E172) Migraleve Pink The active ingredients in Migraleve Pink include: Paracetamol DC 96% (520 mg), equivalent to 500 mg of paracetamol. Codeine phosphate (8 mg). Additional excipients in Migraleve Pink include: Magnesium stearate Colloidal anhydrous silica Stearic acid Pregelatinised maize starch Gelatin Hypromellose Macrogol Erythrosine (E127) Aluminium oxide Titanium dioxide (E171) Licensing and Manufacturing The product license holder for Migraleve is Pfizer Consumer Healthcare, based in Walton-on-the-Hill, Surrey, KT20 7NS, United Kingdom. The manufacturing of Migraleve is carried out by Gödecke GmbH, located at Mooswaldallee 1, 79090, Freiburg, Germany.
